expectations.text: Every shot prompt is self-contained: camera, lighting or style, palette and audio all appear inside the same prompt text, so nothing has to be appended by hand
expectations.evidence: All 12 prompt blocks in GEMINI_PASTE.json carry camera, lighting, style, palette, audio and avoid inline

expectations.text: Names one explicit consistency anchor — a concrete recurring visual element repeated across all shots
expectations.evidence: Anchor named: one warm amber practical + one cold slate-blue window, warm/cold ratio used as the film's clock (90/10 -> 15/85)

expectations.text: Shot count is derived from the 30s runtime and the assumed clip length, and the assumed clip length is stated
expectations.evidence: 6 shots x 8s stated, trimmed to 30s with selection headroom; clip length assumption written out

expectations.text: Every shot prompt carries an avoid / negative list
Prompt text is in English while the explanation to the user is in Czech
expectations.evidence: ZIMNI_NABIDKA_shoty.md explains in Czech, all paste strings are English

expectations.text: States delivery mechanics: hold the seed fixed and/or chain the last frame into the next shot
expectations.evidence: Fixed seed and last-frame chaining both stated in the run instructions

expectations.text: Vertical or square framing is addressed, since the target is Instagram rather than 16:9
expectations.evidence: 9:16 addressed; action centred so a 16:9 generation survives a vertical crop
